paragraphs.raw_text: DOC_ID: WLD-0027 EVENT_ID: NONE TITLE: Solen Energy sponsors coastal clean-up SOURCE_NAME: Raven Wire SOURCE_TYPE: company_statement RELIABILITY: 2 PUB_DATE: 2024-11-08 PUB_TIME: 13:15 COUNTRY: Solvar SECTOR: general LANGUAGE: en --- Solen Energy sponsors coastal clean-up

[P1] Solen Energy has agreed to fund a year of monthly beach clean-ups along the northern coast. The company will pay for gloves, bags and a small truck, while local volunteers will organise the work itself.
[P2] The first clean-up is planned for the last weekend of the month. Volunteers will meet at a car park near the dunes and work in small groups, with a hot drink provided at the end of the morning.

[P3] A company spokesperson said the sponsorship is part of a wider community programme and does not change the firm's normal operations. Local organisers said they hope to collect data on the most common types of litter.
